newsitem.title: USA: CBOT OVERNIGHT PROJECT A AG VOLUME 706 CONTRACTS.
newsitem.headline: CBOT OVERNIGHT PROJECT A AG VOLUME 706 CONTRACTS.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totaled 706 contracts compared with 2,227 overnight Wednesday.
There were 78 wheat, 262 corn, 310 soybean, 28 soymeal, three soyoil, three corn puts and 22 soybean calls traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was 1/4 to 3/4 cent lower, corn was one to 1-1/2 cents higher and soybeans were 1-3/4 cents higher to 5-1/2 cents lower.
